events.label: founding
events.text: Founded as a sloboda named Pokrovskaya Sloboda by Ukrainian Chumak settlers.

evidence.quote: Engels was founded as a sloboda named Pokrovskaya Sloboda by Ukrainian Chumak settlers in 1747
It was granted official town status and renamed Pokrovsk ( ) in 1914

events.text: Began serving as capital of the Volga German ASSR.

evidence.quote: in 1918 it became the capital of the newly established Volga German Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic

events.text: Renamed Engels in honour of Friedrich Engels.

evidence.quote: until it was renamed after Friedrich Engels in 1931

events.text: Ended service as capital of the Volga German ASSR.

evidence.quote: of the Volga German Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic from 1918 to 1941

events.text: City became part of Saratov Oblast after the ASSR was disestablished.

evidence.quote: The Volga German ASSR was disestablished in 1941 following the German invasion of the Soviet Union

events.label: monument
events.text: Monument to the Russian-German victims of repression unveiled in the city

evidence.quote: On August 26 , 2011 , a monument in honor of the Russian-German victims of repression within the Soviet Union was unveiled in the city

events.label: factory
events.text: First Locomotive Company's factory inaugurated at Engels with a prototype Bombardier Traxx locomotive unveiled

evidence.quote: In August 2015 a prototype 1520 mm gauge Bombardier Traxx F120MS locomotive was unveiled at a ceremony to mark the inauguration of First Locomotive Companys factory at Engels
